class.name: SmartObjectSlotReservations
class.brief_description: Server-owned, exclusive smart-object slot reservations with bounded leases and deterministic preference order.
class.description: A data-only claim allocator inspired by Unreal Engine Smart Objects slots. Intended for a server to allocate independently validated interaction positions among agents without sharing the same slot. Claimants provide 1 to 16 unique positive slot IDs in preference order, a positive actor ID, and a finite lease duration from zero (exclusive) to 5 seconds. A maximum of 2,048 actor claims can coexist; each actor may own at most one slot, with a claim renewed in place if the same slot is still among requested candidates. Failed claims never revoke existing claims. The caller advances lease time explicitly and controls all positions, tags, eligibility, authoritative movement, and damage. There are no scene-tree, collision, or networking calls.

method.name: try_claim_first
method.description: Returns an exclusively claimed slot ID, or zero if all requested slots are occupied or any argument is invalid. Reclaims an actor-owned candidate first even when not ranked first, and renews its lease; otherwise atomically transfers the actor to the first unoccupied candidate. Candidate count 1 to 16, lease (0, 5] seconds, positive unique slot IDs and actor IDs required.

method.name: release_slot
method.description: Only the actor owning the slot may release it. Returns whether that reservation was removed.

method.name: release_actor
method.description: Removes all claims held by an actor (normally zero or one). Useful for explicit despawn cleanup.

method.name: advance_time
method.description: Advances leases once per authoritative simulation tick. Ignores invalid or nonpositive deltas.

method.name: get_owner
method.description: Returns the owner actor ID, or zero if this slot is free.

method.name: get_claim_count
method.description: Returns the active claim count (at most 2048).

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all reservations. No client state or saved data are changed.
